description: Dataset and description of an EnergyPLAN model of the Italian energy system in 2021 is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Sara Bellocchi, Michele Manno (University of Rome Tor Vergata). This document describes an EnergyPLAN model of the Italian energy systems for the year 2021. The dataset, consisting of the EnergyPLAN input files necessary to run the simulation, is also provided. See the EnergyPlan website (https://www.energyplan.eu/) for instructions. Coverage: national (IT); the metadata date the deposit to 2023. The repository holds 3 deposits of this kind (versions, parts or per-site or per-year releases); this record describes the series through its most recent member and lists the others in the notes. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
